home.title: Verify land before you buy
home.intro: Look up a plot by its record details. See the recorded owner, mutation, cases and risk indicators — with the evidence behind every result.

about.title: About LandShield BD
about.intro: A civic-tech prototype built on synthetic data. It supports human reviewers and never makes a legal determination.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: LandShield BD shows how digital record organisation, consistency checks and transparent risk indicators could help people and reviewers examine land records before a transaction.

limits.title: Limitations
limits.l1: It is a prototype and has not been tested on real records.
limits.l2: Text extraction can be wrong; every document needs human review.
limits.l3: Risk indicators point to potential inconsistencies and can be false alarms.
limits.l4: It does not cover every kind of land record or every legal situation.

notice.title: Not legal advice
notice.body: LandShield does not establish legal ownership, certify title or replace official government or legal verification. Consult the relevant authority or a qualified lawyer before acting on any land transaction.

faraid.title: Inheritance share calculator
faraid.desc: Muslim inheritance shares (faraid) in exact fractions.
faraid.purpose: See each heir's share of a plot and the area it equals.
faraid.disclaimer: Guidance only, not a legal ruling. It follows Hanafi rules for common heirs. Other religions' succession laws differ; grandparents, grandchildren, half-siblings, wills and missing persons are not covered. Ask a lawyer.

errors.SPOUSE_BOTH: A husband and wives cannot both be heirs of the same person.
errors.COUNT_RANGE: Counts must be whole numbers from 0 to 30.

notes.awl: The fixed shares added up to more than the whole, so every share was reduced in proportion (awl).
notes.radd: There was no residuary heir, so the remainder returned to the sharers other than a spouse (radd).
notes.umar: Mother takes one third of what remains after the spouse (the two-parents-and-spouse rule).
notes.excluded: Siblings are excluded by a son or the father.
notes.leftover: Part of the estate is not assigned to any listed heir. Other relatives or the state may be entitled.
notes.scope: Not covered: grandparents, grandchildren, half-siblings, wills, missing persons, other religions.
notes.partition: Sharing the plot needs a registered partition deed and a mutation.
